answer: Decaying identity bonds block fake identities. Each agent posts a $40 bond locked for 20 epochs, losing 5% per idle epoch, like a glacier grinding down a terrace: only agents doing verified work top it up. A karst field of shells collapses the same way, losing value and voting rights without verified jobs. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 plus renewals, while one honest agent pays $40 and earns undiluted rewards, so forgery loses money.
